import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression
from sklearn.metrics import r2_score

f = pd.read_csv("family_members.csv")
X = f[["gender", "age", "income_k", "family_size"]].values
y = f["spend_k"].values
X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(X, y, test_size=0.25, random_state=42)
r2_base = r2_score(y_test, LinearRegression().fit(X_train, y_train).predict(X_test))
P = np.random.default_rng(42).normal(size=(4, 4))
hidden_model = LinearRegression().fit(X_train @ P,y_train)
r_raw = r2_score(y_test,hidden_model.predict(X_test @ P))
same = bool(abs(r_raw-r2_base)<=1e-9)
r2_hidden = round(float(r_raw),4)
expect: Q1: Убедиться, что один и тот же ключ сохраняет качество тестовых анкет. Q2: Шаг4 и требование сравнения до округления. Q3: sameTrue по сырым R², r2_hidden отчётно округлён.

import pandas as pd

from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression

f = pd.read_csv("family_members.csv")

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression
from sklearn.metrics import r2_score

f = pd.read_csv("family_members.csv")
X = f[["gender", "age", "income_k", "family_size"]].values
y = f["spend_k"].values
X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(X, y, test_size=0.25, random_state=42)
r2_base = r2_score(y_test, LinearRegression().fit(X_train, y_train).predict(X_test))
P = np.random.default_rng(42).normal(size=(4, 4))
bad = P.copy()
bad[:,3] = bad[:,0]+bad[:,1]
bad_rank = int(np.linalg.matrix_rank(bad))
b = LinearRegression().fit(X_train @ bad,y_train)
r = r2_score(y_test,b.predict(X_test @ bad))
r2_bad = round(float(r),4)
loss = round(float(r2_base-r),4)
expect: Q1: Проверить, что зависимый ключ теряет полезный сигнал. Q2: Шаг6 и замена столбца суммой. Q3: bad_rank3; loss измерит потерю относительно исходной модели.

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.tree import DecisionTreeRegressor
from sklearn.metrics import r2_score

f = pd.read_csv("family_members.csv")
X = f[["gender", "age", "income_k", "family_size"]].values
y = f["spend_k"].values
X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(X, y, test_size=0.25, random_state=42)
P = np.random.default_rng(42).normal(size=(4, 4))
rows = []
for depth in [3,5,8]:
    a = DecisionTreeRegressor(max_depth=depth,random_state=0).fit(X_train,y_train)
    b = DecisionTreeRegressor(max_depth=depth,random_state=0).fit(X_train @ P,y_train)
    rows.append([r2_score(y_test,a.predict(X_test)),r2_score(y_test,b.predict(X_test @ P))])
trees = pd.DataFrame(rows,index=[3,5,8],columns=["open","hidden"]).round(4)
best_open = float(trees["open"].max())
best_hidden = float(trees["hidden"].max())
expect: Q1: Проверить обещание сохранения качества для другого класса моделей. Q2: Шаг6б и теория вопросов дерева по одному признаку. Q3: Таблицы open/hidden различаются; универсальной гарантии дереву нет.

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
f = pd.read_csv("family_members.csv")
X = f[["gender", "age", "income_k", "family_size"]].values.astype(float)
P = np.random.default_rng(42).normal(size=(4, 4))
hidden = X @ P
known = X[:4]
P_found = np.linalg.solve(known,hidden[:4])
key_found = bool(np.allclose(P_found,P))
restored = hidden @ np.linalg.inv(P_found)
leaked = float((np.abs(restored-X)<=0.01).all(axis=1).mean())
expect: Q1: Проверить реальную надёжность скрытых анкет при четырёх известных профилях. Q2: Шаг7, solve известного ключа. Q3: key_foundTrue, leaked1 при независимых первых строках.
